description: This file defines the ContentTranslationPermissions class, which provides dynamic permissions related to content translation in Drupal. It manages permissions for entity types and bundles, integrating with Drupal's entity and translation systems.

classes.name: ContentTranslationPermissions
classes.description: Provides dynamic permissions for content translation, managing permissions for entity types and bundles within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the permissions class with entity type manager, content translation manager, and bundle info services.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class using the service container.

methods.name: contentPermissions
methods.description: Generates an array of permissions for translating entity types and bundles based on their enabled status and permission granularity.

methods.name: buildBundlePermission
methods.description: Builds a permission array for a specific bundle, including dependencies on bundle entities if applicable.
